{{Top}}
An '''airbus''' was a [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsorlift]] air transport vessel found on worlds such as [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] during the reign of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].

Some airbuses were used as public transports, while others were reserved to members of the government, or members of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]]. The simplistic structures of air buses meant that a design could be scaled upwards and downwards, accommodating smaller speeder-sized vehicles for short bus-routes and behemoth vessels for trans-continental and trans-orbital journeys.
